title: The Principles and Process of Generational Transition
paragraphs: Therefore, I want to address the topic of the principle and process of intergenerational transmission. The principle and process of intergenerational transmission. It is amazing that sometimes we do not understand the times we live in. There was a nation that impressed God. Or rather, a tribe that impressed God. Israel had 12 tribes, and God singled out one of them as the most important tribe, and it was not the tribe of Judah. He said that the name of that tribe was Issachar.

God has told us precisely why the tribe of Issachar was so important among the twelve tribes. He said that they possessed two things that the other tribes did not possess. They were actually the smallest tribe, and they did not have an army, yet they were the most important tribe. He said they were important because, firstly, they understood the times. Secondly, as a result, they knew what they had to do. He said that this is why they are the most important tribe in Israel.

They understood the times, and based on that, they knew what they should do. On one occasion, Jesus said to the people in the community where he lived, especially the religious leaders. He said, "You do not know the time of your loss." In other words, it is possible to live in a moment and not understand the nature of that moment. Therefore, you don't know what you should do at that moment. We have entered a historic moment as a country. This moment concerns our nation, and God always thinks of nations.

The principle of the nation was created by God. God establishes nations, and He establishes them for a reason. Therefore, the Bahamas was not founded by a group of men sitting around a table. They were being used by a greater divine power to accomplish a divine purpose. Therefore, the Bahamas were founded by God in heaven before they came into existence on Earth. There was a timing for that. In fact, I think it is important to understand that the nations created by God began when God first created Adam.

God intended that the earth should have one nation, and that this nation should be headed by the human race. Therefore, all nations are the product of God's creation. In the book of Malachi, chapter 12, verse 21 it says: “And in his name the nations will put their hope.” We put our hopes in many things, but God says, “I want the nations to trust in me.” How do we know that God created nations? Let us read a verse that you have heard previously at this celebration. Acts of the Apostles, Chapter 17, Verse 24.

Can we read it aloud together? Please read on. The God who created the world and everything in it, the Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made by hands. He is not served by the hands of men as if he needed anything, since he gives everyone life, breath, and everything. The following verse. From one blood he made every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and he determined the appointed times and the boundaries of their dwelling place. The following verse.

He says that God did this so that they would seek the Lord, perhaps they would touch him and find him, even though he is not far from each one of us. Because through Him we live, move, and have our being. As some of your poets have also said: Because we too are his descendants. I want you to write down exactly what that verse told us. I have extracted it for you. Number one, why did God create nations? Okay, first, write this down. God says that He created the nations.

Number two, he creates nations for a period of time. The verse says that he set times for them. This means that every nation has a time, and there is something it must do during that time. Some nations have disappeared, and some nations are dying. Her time had run out. Next, he says that nations are formed by God's choice. You have just read in the Bible that he chooses who will live there. Very few of us are of Caribbean descent. Perhaps none of us.

Something, either a boat or an airplane, transported us here at some point in history. So he chose to create a country called the Bahamas from people from different places. He continues to contribute to this nation from various places. Next, he says: "The positions of nations are determined by God's choice." He says he chooses who will be in it and where it should be. The location of the Bahamas was determined by God. We are in a strategic location by divine decree.

I don't think our own government realizes the importance of our proximity to the nations surrounding us. We do not exploit our position. But God also says something else. He says he is creating the nation. Write that down. What should people do? Look for him. The purpose of any state is for people to find God. This is clear in the Bible. So, when people come to your country, do they see God? Do they feel God's presence? Do your policies and legislation reflect God? Does your culture reflect God?

Nations such as the Canaanites, Hittites, and Jebusites no longer exist. Do you know why? They began to worship idols. They began sacrificing their children by dipping them in goat's milk. They burned their children on the altar. They killed girls as young as twelve as sacrifices to " Molk". In other words, God is saying: "Look, if you have a culture that does not represent me, I will wipe you off the face of the earth." We can no longer find these nations.

So, when your country starts sacrificing children, we call that abortion. You are tampering with the very essence of your country's life. Do not think that you are immune from being destroyed by God. God is able to end the existence of a state. We cannot find the Moabites. Do you know that the land of Canaan, Canaan, should I say this? Canaan was the black son of Noah. This means that African heritage ruled the land of Canaan. Guess who took it?

God said to Moses, “I will take you to the land of Canaan, because its people have defiled the land.” They began to worship devils. They began offering sacrifices to the gods. They burned their children in Canaan. The Canaanites became wicked, and God gave their land to someone else. If you do not bring God into your land, other people will take over your country. Then he says: "So that they may touch it." This is the reason why God created a state. So that people can find it.

He says: "This is why God makes a nation for him." So that people may depend on God, not on their geniuses. It is I, he says, who gives you life and soul. Not the investor. Not a commercial banker who comes in to hire a few people. He said, "It is I who give you life." Never tie your life to a barrel that might run dry. Call upon an eternal God who never runs out. In other words, he is saying, create a culture that introduces people to God.

He wants you, as a nation, to make sure that everything you do will establish moral standards that demonstrate the nature of God. Any nation that has a moral code that does not represent God will perish. We do not learn from history. We still don't understand the message. Some of the things we are doing now are so important that we need to review the decisions and laws we are making. Look at Revelation 5:9. Let's read it together, please.

And with your blood you have purchased for God people of every tribe, tongue, people and nation. What did you make them? A kingdom of priests who serve the Lord. And what will they own? the earth. In other words, God is saying, "I created the nations to be a kingdom of priests for me." Look at the Book of Psalms, Chapter 2, Verse 1. Read it. Please come in. Why do nations conspire, and why do people imagine false things? The kings of the earth take their positions. Read it aloud.

The rulers joined together against the Lord and against his Messiah. They say: Let us break their chains, and let us cast off their shackles. In other words, let's get rid of God. We don't want anyone dictating what we do. We do n't want God in our politics. We don't want God in our laws. Let's break what is called this spiritual constraint. We need to be free. And God says that they are plotting against him. This means that they are enacting laws directly against God and completely contrary to what God wants.

Very dangerous. Look at the following verse. Please read aloud. Psalm 2:4. Read. And He who dwells in the heavens laughs. The Lord is mocking them. Then he rebukes them in anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying, “I have set my king over Zion, my holy mountain, for I will disregard your laws and bring Jesus.” You will reach a point where you realize that it is still the path to national development. Can I hear Amen? Amen. Please applaud God. Therefore, the nation is a component created by God.

Every nation should possess these things. Write it down. A common language, common values, a common covenant, a common culture, common moral standards, and common respect. They should participate in these matters. This means that the nation must adhere to unity. The key to building a nation is for it to have a national goal, a national vision, and a national divine reference. This is important. In other words, they must refer all their legal decisions to a higher authority.

Fourth, they must have a national ethical charter. They must have a national value system. They must have a national social awareness. They must have a patriotic spirit of love and respect for one another. This is what nations are built upon. Look at Psalm, I mean Genesis 12:12. Read the first verse. Then the Lord said to Abraham, “ Go ahead, read it aloud.” Then the Lord said to Abraham, “Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land which…what? I will show you, the land of Canaan.”

The following verse. I will make you a great nation. There was already a nation in that land. In other words, God can destroy your country. And you don't even know that it was cancelled. And the foreigners begin to arrive. You don't realize that your time is up. Sooner or later, they will outnumber you. God did not send Abraham to an empty land. Rather, he sent him to a land inhabited by the Canaanites, Moabites, Jebusites, and Hittites.

In other words, God can dismiss you from your job while you are still in charge of your position. Amen. When you start doing evil, God will slowly take control of your country and you will find strangers in the House of Representatives. O Abraham, I will give you a nation, a land where other people will live. He says, look at the following verse. Three, I will make you a great nation and I will bless you.

I will magnify your name, and you will be a blessing; I will bless those who bless you, and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you. I will bless the nations through your nation. In other words, God created the nation of Israel to be a blessing to the nations, and to be a standard for the nations. Look at Deuteronomy 4:6. Three, therefore, keep them and do them, for that is your wisdom.

He says, and understands the nations that hear of all these ordinances, and they say, what? Indeed, this great nation is a wise and understanding people. And what great nation has gods as close to it as the Lord our God is to all our prayers to Him? Look at verse eight. Read aloud. What great nation has such just laws and rulings as all this law that I am setting before you today? God says, "What makes you different are the rules you make." Nations are currently enacting very dangerous laws.

Look at the following verse. Read, though the whole earth is mine, you will be mine a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. These are the words with which you will address the Children of Israel. In other words, I want a nation, not a church or a religion. I want to build a nation. He says: Look at Psalm 33:12, read: “ Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, and the people whom he has chosen as his inheritance.” Look at Psalm 33:16.

Read: “A king cannot be saved by the size of his army, nor can a mighty man deliver by the greatness of his power.” Therefore, law enforcement will not solve our criminal problems. You can build defense forces as you wish. God said that this will not protect your country. You can put bars on your windows and surveillance cameras everywhere. Oh God, that will not protect your country. Your strength will not save you. He says that we spend billions in the world and in countries to build armies and enhance security.

God said: I will not protect your city. I am the only one who will protect your country. Look at Psalm 33. Read: “The eye of the Lord is on those who fear him.” God says: You do not need any more weapons of war. You need the fear of God to return to your country. People no longer fear God. God said: That's why you need lots of police dogs and more police cars. You need a lot of weapons because you do not fear God. Watch this. Read it again.

The Lord’s eye will be on the nation that fears Him, on those who place their hope in His unfailing love to save them from death and keep them alive amidst the economic crisis. Applause, applause, applause. According to God, I know this sometimes sounds ridiculous, but according to God, if you fear Him, He will change the state of your economy. Among all nations. Something will happen in your country. You might discover oil in your backyard if you fear God. He says: If you fear me, I will protect you from famine.

This means that other countries will collapse economically, but you will remain protected because of what? Fear of God. I hope and pray that our Prime Minister will declare one day this week a day of fasting and prayer, and grant us a holiday just to pray. Not for dancing and fun, but for prayer. Why? Because he says: If we fear God again, I will change the state of the economy. You all act as if you are believers, only in the God you read about in the Bible. What will the fear of God protect you from?

From agriculture. He says it's an economic crisis. Look at Proverbs 11:14. Read: “Where there is no planning, a nation falls.” This means they lack sound advice. They keep making bad decisions because they get bad advice from the wrong people. They hire incompetent advisors, and the nation falls. But with so many good advisors, what does he say? Salvation is guaranteed. In other words, you should review the quality of the people from whom you take advice. You know, every nation wants to be successful, don't you?

That's why we sing " Advance, land of the Bahamas". We want to move towards greatness. Every country wants to be successful. What is the key or keys to national success? I want to show you where we are now. I want to read quickly from our constitution, from our preamble. She says: "For 481 years ago, the rediscovery and establishment of islands and rocks was the key to the beginning of a new world." I want to focus on one word right now.

And since the people of this family of islands understand that the preservation of their liberty—let us all say liberty— will be assured by a national commitment to self-discipline, hard work, loyalty, unity, and enduring respect for Christian values ​​and the rule of law. Now I want you to focus on the word "freedom". The goal here is freedom. Let me prove it. Look at the following phrase in the constitution. And what does she say?

Now know that we, the heirs and successors of this family of islands, recognize the sovereignty of God and believe in the fundamental rights and freedoms of the individual. We hereby declare in solemn praise the establishment of a free state. Here is the word "free" again. Every page speaks of freedom. freedom. freedom. freedom. Say it all: Freedom. freedom. A free, democratic, and sovereign nation, founded on spiritual values, in which no man, woman, or child should be what?

Slaves to someone, or having their work exploited, or having their lives ruined by deprivation. Now, I want you to note that this whole thing is about freedom. Do you know why? The Bahamas was a slave colony. I've had a taste of that a little. My father is here this morning. He is 89 years old. He knew what it meant to be truly oppressed. I remember when we couldn't drive west, near the hotel that is currently being built. There was a barrier across the road like "Layford Quay". We couldn't drive any further.

Some of you young people don't know that. That was the beginning, where life began. It started right there, where the hotel is now located. We used to go driving on Sunday mornings. I mean Sunday evenings after church. My father used to take us in that big car. When we got there, we had to stop. The police say: " Go back." You couldn't go through Bay Street. Why? Only white people can live there. They call it " apartheid". I remember when no one could go to Queen's College unless they were white.

When I joined Queen's College, there were very few of us. We got in because our grades were exceptional, not because they wanted us. The government was forced to compel them to accept us. I have tasted that. I remember when we were walking down Bay Street, we had to pass some places quickly because they would say, "What are you doing here?" Restaurants we couldn't enter. They had a sign in the back that said "Blacks only". That was in the Bahamas. So, you could have gone back and received the service.

You couldn't enter through the front door. You couldn't sit in the restaurant. Only white people could sit there. You guys don't know that. I've been through this. There were cinemas in the city that you couldn't go to. For eggs only. They say: "Cinema is only for white people." So when movies came here, we couldn't watch them. It was intended for eggs only. I am not biased. I'm just telling you the facts. So when they talk about freedom in this constitution, they say, "Look, this will never happen again."

And some of you, when we were supposed to dance this morning, it was nice, man. I was dancing because I was remembering those things, man. 40 years is equivalent to a whole generation. I will dance my last dance because I lived through a generation in which we were freed from that. Now, I want to tell you something very important here. God always promises freedom while you are in a land of slavery. God told the Israelites that there was a land flowing with milk and honey.

Tell them this while they are in slavery, for God always gives you a promise of light when you are in darkness. Secondly, God always sends a savior to deliver you from physical persecution. Physical abuse. But here lies the problem. God does not take oppressed peoples directly to freedom. Write this down. God will not take oppressed peoples directly to freedom. never. If you study history, you will find that it did not lead them directly to freedom because their minds were a problem. And I want to say this now.

The Bahamas are not yet free. We are free. Do n't confuse the two. In other words, God will always lead people to a stage of salvation, a period in which He gives them the opportunity to learn how to live in freedom. Because freedom is a difficult place to live. Yes. Yes. It took them 40 years to get to that point. Do you understand the significance of the times? When they reached the age of 40, God said, "If you do not change your minds, I will destroy you." This is found in the Bible.

It gives you 40 years to change your thinking from a "crab" mentality to being free from it. It gives you 40 years to shift your thinking from killing your brothers and sisters, from hindering their progress, from impeding their advancement. It gives you 40 years to change your mindset. I know exactly where we are now. Actually, here's what I think might be helpful. Exodus 13:17. Let's read aloud. Begin. When Pharaoh released it, come on, read aloud.

When Pharaoh released the people, God did not lead them through the land of the Philistines, even though it was shorter. Stop reading. My wife and I went to Egypt years ago, and we moved from Egypt to Israel. We flew from Tel Aviv to Cairo. It took 20 minutes. When I landed, I was confused. I said to my guide, "Oh, why did we arrive so quickly?" He said: "Well, it takes 40 days to walk from Cairo to Tel Aviv. " No, let me say it slowly. The journey from Egypt to Canaan takes 40 days. 40 days.

God says, "I will not take them by the shortcut." Read the following phrase. He says, "Because if they face war," which means responsibility, pressure, and conflict, "they may change their minds and return to slavery." Oh my God, there are some people today who still want to come back. God says, "I could get you there in 40 days, but it's not your location that matters to me. It's your mindset." Read the following words. Verse 18. So God led them around the wilderness. Who led them? God.

He led them around the overland route towards the Red Sea. He led them to a test to examine their minds. The text says that the Israelites left Egypt armed for war. They didn't know how to fight. They never had an army. In other words, you wear a suit but you're not good at math. You wear an elegant dress, but you are still unable to ride a bicycle. They are armed, but they don't know where they are fighting. They cannot fight. We look good, but we can't handle it. They still believe that you cannot own a hotel.

They still believe that you cannot own a bank. They still believe that you cannot own a global corporation. They just say get a job, tidy up the family, and remove the weeds. They say this is all you're worth in your suit. Remove the weeds. Stylish appearance but no fighting ability. Can you hear me? God says, "I will lead them on the long road." Listen, God cares more about changing you than about changing your location. Oh God, I don't want you to go to Canaan yet because you don't have the mentality of Canaan.

So, I will keep you in this desert for 40 years. God's promises always require preparation. God will never give you what you are not qualified to manage. They were unable to manage their freedom. So he put them in a classroom called Sinai for 40 years to see if they could be mentally trained to take responsibility, and they failed the test. They have already failed the test. In fact, true freedom imposes more rules, requires more work, and demands greater responsibility than slavery.

Freedom is taking responsibility for your own life. We don't want to do that. We still believe that foreigners are smarter, and investors are smarter, so we give them all kinds of advantages and all kinds of opportunities, and we still do not trust our own people because we are fighting the spirit of "you are not responsible yet." We have behavioral scientists with PhDs who cannot be allowed to ride a bicycle. And we have people who have just graduated from high school taking over their leadership. 40 years old.

Please stay with me. You cannot ignore this day. I'm telling you now. This is extremely important. Transformation is more important than transition. Write this down. In other words, mental freedom is more important than physical survival. Nothing corrupts Canaan more than thinking about slavery in Egypt. This is why Canaan requires a transformation. The enemy of freedom is the slave mentality. And freedom is very special. God will keep you out of it until you acquire a mindset of freedom.

In other words, you need to change your mindset in order to enjoy the transition. God always provides miraculously when you are in the stage of salvation. That's why we survived for 40 years. We still can't believe how we managed to do that. Our tourism industry has flourished in the last forty years. We cannot take credit for that ourselves. It is a miracle that a country that has nothing but rocks and sand receives 6 million tourists. All of this can be erased in one day. Therefore, we must be careful.

It's a miracle. God offers miracles and salvation. He gave them free food, free clothing, and free water from a rock. He gave them a free cure from a snake on a staff. Everything was free. Why? Miracles and salvation. But when the forty years are over, the manna stops. The water no longer flows from the rock, and the snake dies. This means you have to dig your own wells, plant your own farms, and eat well to feed yourself. 40 years old.

God will not take a people to the land of freedom until He removes the land of slavery from their minds. In other words, God is willing to wait for the right generation to enter the land of freedom. He will wait even if he has to wait 40 years. Can I phrase it this way? God always raises up a new leader to take the people to freedom. When people reach the land of freedom, the miraculous stops and the work begins. In the land of freedom, you must grow your own food.

You should sew your own clothes and build your own houses. In freedom, you must fight your own battles. Good heavens, we are still asking for outside help. You know, when they left Egypt, they didn't fight anyone at all. God Himself destroyed Pharaoh's entire army. They never fought. But when they entered the land of Canaan on the first day, the first thing Joshua saw was Jericho. The first thing he saw was a man wearing armor. The first thing Moses saw was a burning bush, a miracle.

The first thing Joshua saw was a man in armor, a warrior. God was saying, "Well, in the time of Moses, everything was a miracle. In the time of Joshua, you have to fight your way through to get what you need." Joshua was forced to fight to possess the land. In other words, a mental breaking of the constraints must occur. Please write this out loud. I want you to write this down. What is the responsibility of freedom? Freedom is a difficult place. We are about to enter it.

40 years means we are about to leave the wilderness and cross over. Forty years is always the mark that God places in the Bible to signify the passage from generation to generation. Let me prove it to you. Here is a verse you may not have seen before. Please write down this verse. I will talk about the number 40 for a minute and I will show you a verse. 40 is the number that symbolizes a generation in the Bible. In fact, the generation is the epitome of national service.

May God grant you 40 years of national service. This means serving your country. After that, it is best that you have completed your task. I'll prove it in a minute. Thirdly, a generation is the completion of one stage and the transition to another. This is what the number 40 means. 40 also means the number of the Caliphate. 40 also means the transfer number. 40 also means the shift number. This means if you don't change by the age of forty, God will get rid of you. Let's see if this is true. Read 2 Samuel 5:4.

Read. David was thirty years old when he became king. And how long is the king? 40 years old. In Hebron, he reigned over Judah for seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem, he reigned over all of Israel for 33 years, which completes the forty. And then David died. Look at the following verse. 1 Kings 11:42. Read. How long did King Solomon reign in Jerusalem? 40 years old. Then he rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And Rehoboam, his son, what did he do?

He succeeded him as king. They are all around forty. Are you still not convinced? Try another one. Psalm 95:10. Read. God says: For forty years I have despised that generation. I said that they are a people whose hearts have gone astray. They did not know my ways. Therefore, I swore, God is promising something. Now, watch this. They will never enter my land. I swear to God, I will end their existence. Because they did n't want to change their mindset.

The people who took over leadership in our country were all over seventy. now. If you assume that they came out of Egypt. The smell of the slave ship is still in their nostrils. Therefore, mentally they cannot cross over. They are good people. Be kind now. They are good people. They have a tremendous desire to cross over, but they are mentally unable to do so. Sometimes we call them intellectually bankrupt. Look, I just read it to you.

God says that when you reach forty, you are supposed to step aside and let someone else take over. 40 years and he stepped aside. In other words, God is saying that at the age of forty, you are no longer capable of creative thinking. So you keep bringing up the old system, the old methods, the old pattern, the same boring repetition. Why? Because you're stuck in the old generation. Applaud God for a new revelation to come. We must understand this matter well.

I now predict that the next general election cannot reappoint the same leaders. impossible. I tell you, according to divine design, this is impossible. Every leader in the Bible ended his mission at forty. And they succeeded in that. Incidentally, David did not wait until he died to hand over the trust to Solomon. Solomon did not wait until he died to hand it over to Rehoboam. In other words, don't wait until you die. Hand it over to them while you are still alive. Take it, my son, and move it to the next level.

I'm stuck. Are there any young people here? Come on, say Amen. We need some of these people to get enlightened. 40 years means that time is up. It either changes or it perishes. Oh God, you must pray for me. Look at this. There is no greater burden than freedom. That is why God says you must be free in order to gain freedom. In other words, everyone demands freedom, but few understand what it means. That's why we can't access it. Freedom is like love and beauty.

You cannot understand it, but you know it when you feel it. That's strange. The human spirit yearns to be free. We have a desire to be free. But here's what I want to conclude with today. There is a picture of a dog tied to a pole. This dog is a real dog. This is a picture of a dog that was the subject of an experiment by a psychologist. They tied the dog to a stake with a chain. Then they placed food in front of the dog, but they placed it so far away that he could not reach it.

The dog was very hungry, so he rushed towards the food with all his might. When he jumped, the chain pulled him backwards by the neck and he suffocated. But he looked at the food, and he was very hungry, so he jumped towards it again, choked, and jumped again. He kept choking and jumping towards the food, but it was too far away. His neck began to deteriorate due to friction with the chain. Then blood began to appear on his neck and he felt pain, so the dog decided that the pain was too much to bear.

It is greater than food. So the dog refused to move. That dog looked at the food after they untied the leash. He was free, but he was afraid to go to the food because he remembered the pain. He was free, but he refused to go to eat. Because he remembered the pain. Look, the problem is the memory of pain. Are we afraid to believe in our ability to do great things at the age of forty? Yes, we are. You go to your government to request a license for a certain activity, and they tell you: " You can't do that."

They will tell you: "You can't do it." How did they know that? They don't know. But they remained tied to the stake for a very long time. Because he said "no" to them for too long. They have come to believe that they cannot access food. Please write this down. This is very important. We can die even if we have resources. Africa is suffering from this right now. The richest continent on Earth is Africa. However, it is the poorest. You can die in the presence of abundance.

Even if you call yourself free, memory is stronger than chains. In other words, the constraint is still in your mind. In other words, we are tied down by a stake. Our social, economic, and religious conditioning ties us together with an invisible stake. Changing location does not guarantee a change in orientation. Your location has changed, but your orientation remains the same. In other words, the new does not guarantee change. Without a mental shift, you can go somewhere new, but continue doing the old things.

What you feed your soul with determines the quality of your life and decides your freedom. In essence, freedom is a result of mental adaptation, not a change of location. The Israelites never reached Canaan. Their location changed, but their mentality never changed. For 40 years they still think the same way. I want to show you something about these people. Do you know? It is possible to be saved but not free. Salvation is the physical transfer and liberation of the person.

It removes the environment of oppression in which you live. Salvation is the separation of the slave from the physical state of slavery. Salvation is simply a physical transfer or breaking of a physical thing. We must never confuse salvation with slavery or freedom. In fact, oppression is the nullification of self-determination. I can no longer control my life. This is called breaking the spirit. Oppression breeds a deep spirit of dependency and lack of self-determination.

When you are enslaved, you become dependent on the master and afraid to think for yourself. This is why there is no creativity among slaves, because the master thinks for them. They were not trained to think about solving their problems with new ideas. A slave mentality can never be creative. Write this down. The slave mentality thinks about pain and plans to complain. The slave mentality always thinks about what cannot be done, and why it cannot be done.

Pain, your mental state is more important than your physical state. You are not truly free until your mind is free. For this reason, at the age of forty as a nation, we must confront our issue. What are we mentally? Freedom is first and foremost a state of mind before it is a physical condition. This was the basis of Jesus Christ's declaration of freedom. He never said that anyone would free you. Rather, he said, “You will know the truth.” What is the truth? Knowing the truth is a mental experience.

You will know the truth about yourself. Something has to happen in your mind, and then you become free. I became free when my mind discovered who I am in Christ. My whole life has changed.
